title: Hayati Pro Max Cherry Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Cherry Ice pairs the bold, fruity taste of Cherry with a crisp menthol layer for a flavour that’s both sweet and punchy and fresh and cool. The Cherry note is deep and slightly tangy, delivering a red berry richness from the first inhale. A brisk menthol finish gives the blend a frosty edge, creating a sharp and refreshing vape that stays authentic and satisfying throughout. Blended with nicotine salts for fast-acting absorption and a smoother inhale, this e-liquid is designed for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with low-powered pod kits and starter devices. The 50VG/50PG ratio ensures consistent vapour production and flavour clarity. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
